items: MPPT charge controller (or hybrid inverter/charger with built-in MPPT)
DC breakers/fuses, disconnect and PV/battery cabling
cart: sungoldpower.com (48 V whole-house kit: SGR-8K10E bundle SKU or SPH6548P + batteries + panels); Amazon (12 V shed/RV/cabin set: panels + MPPT + 12 V LiFePO4 + inverter + fusing)
why: In both chats ChatGPT showed no product cards. It listed panels, an MPPT controller, LiFePO4 batteries, an off-grid inverter and protection gear as required parts, and it split sizes from shed/RV (400–800 W, 1–5 kWh) up to whole house (8–20 kW, 20–60 kWh). The deciding fact is system voltage: small loads run on a 12 V bank with a separate MPPT and inverter, while above roughly 3 kW ChatGPT itself recommends a 48 V bank with an integrated inverter/charger, so the battery voltage, the controller's PV input limits and the inverter's DC input must all match, and one cart per tier can hold a matched set.
